text: The Environment Canterbury Climate Resilience Programme (CRP) was a portfolio of eight projects implemented between 2020 and 2023 to enhance flood resilience and support regional COVID-19 recovery in the Canterbury region of New Zealand. The programme, co-funded by the central government and local entities, focused on nature-based solutions to manage riverine flood risks, promote biodiversity, and integrate cultural values into flood protection strategies.
